description: baseline torch.geqrf compact QR

Reduce Python and launch overhead around the existing torch.geqrf baseline by adding shape-specialized dispatch, caching, preallocation, and avoiding redundant clones or synchronizations without changing numerical semantics.
Use shape-keyed reusable H/tau buffers with torch.geqrf out= to reduce allocation overhead; passed validation but geomean regressed to 116569257 ns.
Hoist torch.geqrf to a module global to shave Python attribute lookup overhead while keeping exact baseline semantics; validation passed, geomean 116242330 ns.
Make custom_kernel a direct torch.geqrf alias, eliminating one Python function frame while preserving baseline semantics; validation passed, geomean 116251271 ns.

Bind custom_kernel directly to torch.ops.aten.geqrf.default to bypass both the Python wrapper frame and torch.geqrf symbol lookup; validation passed, geomean 116255668 ns, essentially baseline/no material win.

Explored micro overhead reductions around torch.geqrf without changing numerical semantics. Reusable out= buffers validated but regressed to 116.57 ms geomean; global/direct aliases were near baseline, with best observed measured row 116.24 ms but within noise and not a material improvement over baseline 116.06 ms. Final branch keeps the direct ATen geqrf alias and has an nsys profile saved; next useful brief should move beyond Python dispatch into fused/custom QR or harness/check overhead is dominating the remaining micro space.

Extend the winning n=32 CUDA C++ Householder path to n=176 and n=352 with shape-specific kernels using CTA-level reductions, explicit routing benchmarks, and hard fallback for n>=512 or stress cases when the custom route is not faster.
Routed n=176 and n=352 to the existing CTA Householder CUDA kernel. Validation passed; n=176 improved to 11.29 ms but n=352 regressed to 82.28 ms, full geomean 118182007 ns.
Kept custom CUDA route for n=176 while hard-falling back n=352 to torch.geqrf after explicit routing showed n=352 was slower. Validation passed; geomean 110931291 ns.
Added a compile-time qr_fixed_kernel<176> route, preserving n=352 fallback. Validation passed; n=176 improved to 10.10 ms and full geomean 109922630 ns.
Specialized the n=176 fixed kernel to 128 CTA threads instead of 256. Validation passed; n=176 improved to 9.96 ms and geomean 109805191 ns.
Tried 64 CTA threads for the n=176 fixed kernel. Validation passed but n=176 regressed to 10.41 ms and geomean 110199798 ns, so 128 threads is preferred.
Restored the best observed 128-thread n=176 fixed QR route after the 64-thread regression; this is the final kept implementation, using the previously measured 109805191 ns geomean.

Extended the n=32 CUDA path to n=176 successfully while explicitly testing and rejecting n=352. Generic n=176+n=352 routing validated but regressed due to n=352; hard-fallback n=352 and a fixed-size n=176 kernel improved the best full geomean to 109805191 ns, with n=176 at about 9.96 ms. 64-thread tuning regressed, so final commit restores 128-thread n=176; final nsys profile saved. Next brief should combine this n=176 route with the worker-1 512 streaming/geqrf-chunk win, and only revisit n=352 with a different tiled/panel algorithm rather than the current one-matrix CTA Householder kernel.

Preserve the 32-stream 640x512 geqrf fast path, graft the n==176 128-thread fixed-CUDA route and n==32 warp route if missing, centralize non-overlapping shape predicates, benchmark all active shapes, and disable any grafted path that regresses.
Combined the 32-stream 640x512 geqrf chunk path with the n=32 warp QR and n=176 128-thread fixed CUDA QR routes using centralized disjoint predicates. Validation passed; full geomean 64031468 ns.

Disabled only the n=176 CUDA route while retaining n=32 CUDA and 32-stream 512 routing to test graft contribution. Validation passed but geomean regressed to 66382673 ns, so n=176 route should stay enabled.
Restored the best combined dispatch with n=32 CUDA, n=176 fixed CUDA, and 32-stream 640x512 geqrf chunks; using prior measured geomean 64031468 ns.

Combined the 32-stream 640x512 geqrf chunk path with the n=32 warp CUDA QR and n=176 fixed 128-thread CUDA QR routes using centralized, disjoint predicates. Full validation passed; combined geomean was 64.03 ms, a large improvement over both parents and baseline. A comparison disabling only n=176 regressed to 66.38 ms, so the n=176 graft is retained; no grafted path regressed enough to disable. Final nsys profile saved for commit 1da95cf5.

Preserve the 32-stream 640x512 and guarded 12-chunk 60x1024 fast paths, graft only the n==32 warp-CUDA and fixed n==176 CUDA routes behind centralized exact predicates, benchmark every active QR shape, and disable any graft that regresses the 46.07ms parent metric.

Combined guarded 32-stream 640x512 and 12-chunk 60x1024 geqrf paths with exact n=32 warp CUDA and n=176 fixed 128-thread CUDA predicates. Validation passed; full geomean 43515739 ns, improving the 46.07 ms parent target.
Disabled only the n=176 CUDA route while keeping n=32 CUDA and 512/1024 stream chunking. Validation passed but geomean regressed to 45168911 ns, so n=176 stays enabled.
Restored the best combined dispatch: n=32 and n=176 CUDA routes plus guarded 640x512 and 60x1024 stream chunking; using measured geomean 43515739 ns.

Combined the guarded 32-stream 640x512 and 12-chunk 60x1024 stream fast paths with exact n=32 warp-CUDA and fixed n=176 CUDA routes. Full validation passed; active-set benchmark geomean was 43.52 ms, improving the 46.07 ms parent target. Disabling n=176 regressed to 45.17 ms, so all grafts are retained. Final nsys report files were generated for commit 475b3dbb, although nsys returned 143 after report generation due target/re-parent termination handling.

Target batch=40,n=352 and n=176 medium QR gaps with guarded stream-chunked torch.geqrf or compact custom CUDA dispatch, sweep stream and chunk counts, preserve existing n=512, n=1024, n=2048, and n=4096 fast routes, benchmark active shapes, and keep only non-regressing wins.

Added guarded 8-stream chunked torch.geqrf routes for batch=40,n=176 and n=352 while preserving existing large-shape routes. Validation passed; n=176 dropped to 2.28 ms, n=352 to 6.14 ms, full geomean 30260422 ns.
Swept 10 chunks for batch=40,n=176 and n=352. Validation passed but medium shapes regressed to 3.08 ms and 8.11 ms, full geomean 31679493 ns; 8 chunks is preferred.
Swept 5 chunks for batch=40,n=176 and n=352. Validation passed but medium shapes regressed to 3.38 ms and 8.77 ms, full geomean 32204115 ns; 8 chunks remains preferred.
Swept asymmetric medium routes with n=176 using 8 chunks and n=352 using 6 chunks. Validation passed; n=352 improved versus 5/10 chunks but full geomean 30869301 ns still regressed versus 8/8.
Restored best observed guarded medium routes: batch=40,n=176 and n=352 both use 8 stream chunks, preserving existing large-shape routes; using measured geomean 30260422 ns.

Targeted batch=40,n=176 and n=352 medium gaps with guarded stream-chunked torch.geqrf while preserving existing n=512, n=1024, n=2048, and n=4096 routes. Best kept result uses 8 chunks for both medium shapes: n=176 improved to 2.28 ms, n=352 to 6.14 ms, full geomean 30.26 ms. Sweeps at 10 chunks, 5 chunks, and asymmetric 8/6 all validated but regressed. Full nsys repeatedly failed due re-parent handling, so a focused n=176/n=352 nsys profile was generated for final commit 578c4235.

Preserve exact n==32 warp CUDA and coordinate-descent tune only guarded stream chunk counts for n176/n352={7,8,9}, n512={24,28,32,36}, n1024={10,12,14}, n2048={6,8,10}, and n4096={1,2}; benchmark all active shapes after accepted changes and keep only a non-regressing total-metric combination.

Coordinate-descent changed only batch=640,n=512 chunk count from 32 to 28, preserving n32 CUDA and all other stream routes. Validation passed; 512 cells improved near 180 ms and full geomean 29033782 ns.
Tried allowed n512 chunk count 24 after the 28-chunk win. Validation passed but 512 cells regressed around 280 ms and full geomean 31305962 ns, so 28 chunks remains preferred.

Coordinate-descent kept n512=28 and changed only batch=60,n=1024 chunk count from 12 to 10. Validation passed; 1024 cells around 52.2 ms and full geomean 27534320 ns, improving the accepted combination.
Tried allowed n1024 chunk count 14 on top of n512=28. Validation passed but 1024 cells regressed around 64.7 ms and full geomean 29024793 ns, so n1024=10 remains preferred.
Tried allowed n2048 chunk count 6 on top of n512=28,n1024=10. Validation passed but 2048 regressed to 23.5 ms and full geomean 28653892 ns, so n2048=8 remains preferred.
Tried allowed n4096 chunk count 1 on top of accepted n512=28,n1024=10,n2048=8. Validation passed but n4096 regressed near 50.6 ms and full geomean 28955692 ns, so n4096=2 remains preferred.

Restored the best observed coordinate-descent combination after the n4096=1 regression: n512=28, n1024=10, n2048=8, n4096=2, and medium n176/n352=8, preserving exact n32 CUDA; using measured geomean 27534320 ns.

Completed micro coordinate-descent brief 5 over guarded stream chunk counts while preserving exact n==32 warp CUDA. Kept n512=28 and n1024=10 as non-regressing wins, restored n2048=8 and n4096=2 after allowed alternatives regressed, and retained medium n176/n352=8. Final kept commit 8e97700c has measured geomean 27534320 ns; focused nsys profile generated for tuned shapes.
